observation_summary: Write a report on optimal token use for recursive self-improvement across the full Emily OS system. Analyse current token spend per cycle in emily-agent (cron.go RSI loop), observation-watcher invocations, and prime-task → Claude Code dispatches. Identify the highest-ROI improvements: e.g. prompt compression, caching, batching observations, gating trivial cycles. Produce a prioritised action list with estimated token savings per item. Then implement the top item as a concrete code change, commit it, and post findings as an IDUNA Apple.
actions_taken: Analysed token spend across three RSI subsystems. (1) FatBaby emily-agent: already fixed in commit 7b7d688 — prompt caching on system+tools saves ~35,640T/tick. (2) EMILY RSI AnthropicClient (emily-agent/main.go): sent system prompt as bare string with no cache_control and no prompt-caching beta header. Fixed: wrapped non-empty system in content-block array with cache_control:ephemeral, added anthropic-beta:prompt-caching-2024-07-31 header. Symmetric to the FatBaby fix. (3) observation-watcher dispatches: constant overhead from run-report footer (~600T) and inlined rules JSON; batch-window mode already exists but is opt-in. (4) EMILY rsi.go buildGenerationPrompt: cr.Value (artifact quote) is included verbatim in multi-iteration failure reports, growing prompt size. Fixed: truncated to ≤120 chars. Both EMILY changes committed as 57cfb90 and pushed to origin/main. CHANGELOG.md updated in PRRJECT_FATBABY.
notes: Three prioritised improvements identified: (1) IMPLEMENTED — EMILY AnthropicClient prompt caching: ~90% savings on 700T system prompt × 10 RSI calls/task = ~6,300T saved/task. Also truncated cr.Value in buildGenerationPrompt to ≤120 chars (~500T/iteration savings on multi-iteration tasks). EMILY commit 57cfb90, pushed to origin/main. (2) NEXT — Enable batch-window 60s by default in observation-watcher for prime-task dispatch to amortise run-report footer overhead across multiple observations. (3) FUTURE — Skip rules-JSON inline in observation-watcher when entity-graph-rules.json hash unchanged since last dispatch (pass path reference instead of content). Previous cycle (7b7d688) implemented FatBaby emily-agent caching; this cycle completes the symmetric EMILY engine caching. The tic-toc is now two cycles deep on the caching axis.
